name: svelte
description: Build with Svelte 5 and SvelteKit: runes, snippets, routing, form actions, and testing, plus the official Svelte MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Write modern Svelte 5 and SvelteKit code with runes, snippets, and current docs.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to the official Svelte MCP server (mcp.svelte.dev), which serves current Svelte 5 and SvelteKit documentation and static-analysis autofixes that catch outdated patterns. Skills cover the runes reactivity model ($state, $derived, $effect, $props), SvelteKit routing with load functions, form actions, and adapters, Svelte 5 component authoring with snippets and event attributes, and testing with Vitest.
defaultPrompt: Migrate this Svelte component from stores and $: to Svelte 5 runes
Add a SvelteKit form action with validation and progressive enhancement
Write Vitest tests for this Svelte 5 component
